title: IRL Speaker
extensionText: Browser source for triggering sounds from Streamer.bot while IRL streaming

options.name: wsHost
options.label: Streamer.bot Websocket Server Hostname (REQUIRED)
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the Streamer.bot Websocket server

options.name: wsEndpoint
options.label: Streamer.bot Websocket Server Endpoint
options.description: The endpoint of the Streamer.bot Websocket server

options.name: wsPort
options.label: Streamer.bot Websocket Server Port
options.description: The port number of the Streamer.bot Websocket server

options.name: secure
options.label: Use a secure connection?
options.description: Secure uses wss scheme when connecting to Streamer.bot Websocket Server

options.name: soundsEndpoint
options.label: Sounds Endpoint
options.description: The endpoint of the HTTP server serving your sound files

options.name: timeout
options.label: Sound length limit (in seconds)
options.description: Sounds longer than this will stop playing after this amount of time

options.name: nodeHost
options.label: Node Server Host
options.description: The hostname of the Node server serving the sound files. Make Node server accessible via Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, or your preferred method
